CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Overview

babelmixr2 lets users fit an nlmixr2/rxode2 model with other estimation and design software through the usual nlmixr2() interface: NONMEM, Monolix, PKNCA, PopED, saemix, lme4::nlmer, FME MCMC, and a pseudo-optimizer. It also imports finished NONMEM/Monolix runs (via nonmem2rx/monolix2rx) as nlmixr2 fit objects with as.nlmixr2(). The package is mostly R with a small C/C++ layer (PopED solving and data conversion). Version and dependencies are in DESCRIPTION (testthat edition 3, roxygen with markdown).

Build and Development Commands

devtools::install()   # or from the shell: R CMD INSTALL .
devtools::document()  # regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE from roxygen

configure/configure.win run inst/tools/workaround.R, which writes src/Makevars (or src/Makevars.win) from src/Makevars.in and strips the RcppArmadillo.h include from src/RcppExports.cpp. Do not edit the generated src/Makevars* by hand; edit src/Makevars.in.

Tests

NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e "devtools::test()"
NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e "devtools::test(filter='nonmem')"   # file name without test- and .R

tests/testthat.R partitions the suite:

  • Locally and on CRAN everything runs (estimation files skip themselves on CRAN with skip_on_cran()).
  • On CI (CI=true, not CRAN), R-CMD-check runs only the fast subset: all files except those in .slowBatches.
  • BABELMIXR2_TEST_BATCH=<n> runs only slow batch n (1 = saemix; 2 = nonmem-read, monolix-read, poped, as-nlmixr2; 3 = nonmem-monolix-stress, nonmem-monolix-nlmixr2lib). The weekly .github/workflows/slow-tests.yaml matrix must match the number of batches; update both together.
  • BABELMIXR2_STRESS_ALL=true makes the nlmixr2lib sweep use every model.
  • On CI/CRAN tests run serially, and on CRAN rxode2 threads are capped at 2.

R CMD check

devtools::check()   # or R CMD build . && R CMD check babelmixr2_*.tar.gz

CI (.github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml) checks macOS, Windows and Ubuntu (release, devel, oldrel-1). Other workflows: test-coverage.yaml, pkgdown.yaml, rhub.yaml, slow-tests.yaml.

Architecture

Estimation methods are nlmixr2est S3 plug-ins

Each method is wired into nlmixr2est through S3 methods on the est class: nlmixr2Est.<est>, getValidNlmixrCtl.<est>, nmObjGetControl.<est>, nmObjHandleControlObject.<est>Control, and rxUiGet.<name> accessors on the model UI. Methods for fmeMcmc and pseudoOptim (and coda::as.mcmc) are registered at load time in R/zzz.R with rxode2::.s3register(); the rest are in NAMESPACE.

Method Main files
NONMEM R/nonmem*.R (nonmemControl.R, nonmemNlmixr2est.R, nonmemRxUiGet*.R build each $ record, nonmemReadData.R, nonmemFailure.R)
Monolix R/monolix*.R (monolixRxUiGetMlxtran*.R build each mlxtran section, monolixReadData.R, monolixPriors.R)
PKNCA R/pknca.R
PopED R/poped.R, src/poped.cpp
saemix R/saemix.R, R/saemixControl.R
nlmer R/nlmer.R, R/nlmerControl.R, R/nlmerRxUiGet.R
FME MCMC R/fmeMcmc.R
pseudoOptim R/pseudoOptim.R

Shared pieces:

  • R/convert.R (bblDatToNonmem(), bblDatToMonolix()) and src/transform.cpp convert nlmixr2 data/DV for the external tools.
  • R/nmGetDistribution*Lines.R write residual-error/distribution lines.
  • R/pruneIf.R prunes if/else blocks for tools that cannot reassign.
  • R/linCmt.R handles linCmt() models; R/units.R handles units.
  • R/fitCache.R caches fits; R/sigdigControl.R maps sigdig to tolerances.
  • R/as.nlmixr2*.R convert nonmem2rx/monolix2rx imports to fits.
  • inst/*.txt are NONMEM code templates ($ERROR, CCONTR) read with system.file() for the error/transform variants.
  • inst/poped/ holds PopED example scripts; inst/stress/ is the NONMEM/Monolix translation stress kit (see inst/stress/README.md).

External programs

NONMEM and Monolix are found via options such as options(babelmixr2.nonmem=) and options(babelmixr2.monolix=) (see nonmemControl()/monolixControl()). Monolix can also run through the optional lixoftConnectors package. Tests that need these programs must skip when they are absent; translation-only tests must not need them.

Compiled code and the rxode2 pointer table

  • src/init.c is the hand-written .Call registration table with hardcoded argument counts. After adding or changing an // [[Rcpp::export]] function, run Rcpp::compileAttributes(".") AND update the prototype and arity in src/init.c.
  • babelmixr2 links to rxode2 through rxode2’s function-pointer table: R/zzz.R records rxode2.api at build time and .iniRxode2Ptr() passes rxode2::.rxode2ptrs() to _babelmixr2_iniRxodePtrs. src/Makevars.in passes the table length as -DRXAPI. A newer rxode2 API requires reinstalling babelmixr2.

Generated files (do not edit manually)

  • R/RcppExports.R, src/RcppExports.cpp – Rcpp::compileAttributes()
  • man/*.Rd, NAMESPACE – devtools::document()
  • README.md – knit from README.Rmd

Code Style

  • Exported functions: camelCase (e.g. nonmemControl, bblDatToNonmem).
  • Internal functions and local variables: .camelCase with a leading dot.
  • S3 methods follow generic.class (e.g. rxUiGet.monolixOmega).
  • Formatting uses air (air.toml, line width 120, indent 2). Model DSL calls (ini, model, rxode2, quote, lotri, …) are skipped so d/dt(...) and x <- 1; label("...") are left as written.
  • Do not use ::: in package code (CRAN flags it). Tests run in the package namespace, so internals can be called by bare name.
  • Use checkmate::assert_*() (not expect_*()) for argument checks, and rxode2::rxReq() for suggested packages; package code must work without Suggests installed (CRAN noSuggests check).
  • Use American English. ASCII only everywhere (CRAN): --, ->, straight quotes, ....
  • NEWS.md has one # babelmixr2 X.Y.Z heading per version followed by bullet entries describing the user-visible change.

Testing Conventions

  • Test files are tests/testthat/test-*.R; reference NONMEM/Monolix runs are stored as zip files and directories next to them.
  • Guard optional packages with skip_if_not_installed() and slow or estimation-heavy tests with skip_on_cran().
  • A new slow test file belongs in a .slowBatches entry in tests/testthat.R, otherwise it runs in every push/PR CI check.

Release / CRAN Cautions

  • cran-comments.md, CRAN-SUBMISSION, benchmarks/, pkgdown/, vignettes/articles/ and similar are excluded via .Rbuildignore; keep new non-package files there too.
  • Vignettes live only in vignettes/articles/ (pkgdown articles, not built on CRAN).
  • Examples and CRAN tests must not need NONMEM, Monolix or unlisted packages.

CRAN tests: never assert on timing

  • Never put a wall-clock timing expectation in a test that can run on CRAN: no expect_lt()/expect_true() on Sys.time() differences, system.time(), proc.time(), bench/microbenchmark results, or any other elapsed-time threshold. CRAN check machines are shared and heavily loaded, so elapsed time there is random and a timing assertion fails at random. Example: nlmixr2plot test-model-diagram.R asserted a modelGraph() call took < 30 s; on CRAN it took 48.4 s and failed.
  • Test the result, not the speed. If a speed regression guard is really needed, put it only in a test that starts with skip_on_cran() (or the package’s own CRAN skip helper), and never in examples or vignettes.
  • Tests that take more than a few seconds should also skip on CRAN.
